cards.title: LFM2.5-DSpark: Up to 3.18x GPU Throughput Gain via Speculative Decoding
cards.why_it_matters: Speculative decoding with a ~300M draft model cutting real inference latency by 57% on function-calling tasks is directly actionable for anyone deploying LFM2.5 on-device or on H100s.
cards.summary: LiquidAI's DSpark combines a DFlash-style parallel backbone, a Markov-chain sequential head, and a confidence-scheduled verifier to accelerate LFM2.5 inference. Draft models (~300M params, 5 layers) yield up to 3.18x GPU throughput on H100 and 2.87x on M4 Max, with 57% average function-calling latency reduction for LFM2.5-2.6B. Quality is identical to greedy baseline by construction. Day-one support for llama.cpp and SGLang is open-sourced.
